title: Sheafification preserves adequacy of a presheaf of modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: If for every affine scheme over S the functor attached to a presheaf F of O-modules on (Sch/S)_tau is adequate, then the lemma asserts that the sheafification of F is adequate (statement lines 1984-1990). The proof computes the plus construction on an affine U = Spec(A): the colimit of Cech H^0 over coverings may be restricted to standard affine tau-coverings, and since all the rings A -> A_i and A -> A_i tensor A_j are flat the Cech H^0 is identified, by the flat base change lemma, with the kernel of a map between products of F(A) tensor A_i; faithful flatness of A -> product A_i then makes that kernel canonically isomorphic to F(A), so the plus construction does not change the value on affines; repeating gives the same for the double plus, whence the associated functors agree and the sheafification is adequate (proof lines 1993-2022). The level is H3: a genuine computation with two named inputs, and the doubling step is stated with its reason.
